items.title: Know Before You Go: An AWS Partner’s Guide to re:Invent 2026
items.summary: We're excited to bring you AWS re:Invent 2026 both in-person and virtually! The conference is November 30 – December 4 in Las Vegas, with virtual opportunities to watch keynotes and Innovation Talks live. To help you prepare, we curated a list of key re:Invent information for AWS Partner and AWS Marketplace communities.
items.creator: Andrew Somera
